name: Harness
description: You can get in and out of the harness by interacting with it using [$[action_use_seat]]. You can place a rescued survivor in any harness by using [$[action_use_seat]] while carrying them.

logicNodes.label: Occupied
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if this harness is occupied by a character.

logicNodes.label: Trigger [$[action_trigger]]
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal when [$[action_trigger]] is held, and off when it is not.

logicNodes.label: Seat Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs the axis, hotkey and occupied data from the seat. (On/Off 1+ : Hotkeys) (On/Off 31 : Trigger) (On/Off 32 : Occupied) (Value 1 : [$[action_left]]/[$[action_right]]) (Value 2 : [$[action_up]]/[$[action_down]]) (Value 3 : [$[action_pedal_left]]/[$[action_pedal_right]]) (Value 4 : [$[action_throttle_up]]/[$[action_throttle_down]])
